description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP PDO driver for Microsoft SQL Server (sqlsrv) within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines classes for handling database connections, metadata retrieval, and record sets specific to the pdo_sqlsrv driver.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_pdo to implement the SQL Server specific behavior via PDO, including transaction mode, metadata, and table querying.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: A class representing a record set for PDO SQL Server with methods to fetch field metadata specialized for this driver.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: A class extending the PDO SQL Server record set to handle array-based result sets with similar field fetching capabilities.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the PDO SQLSRV driver with settings such as transaction capabilities and timestamp formats.

methods.name: setTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the current connection based on the specified mode.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns false; placeholder for column metadata retrieval.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Returns false; placeholder for table metadata retrieval.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Delegates to ADOConnection::SelectLimit to execute SQL with row limiting.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Delegates to ADOConnection::ServerInfo to retrieve database server information.

methods.name: fetchField
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific field in the record set, including name, type, length, and precision, with driver-specific handling.
